title.en: New York in Eight Growth Rings

intro: At Manhattan's southern tip, a Dutch fort and palisade launch a city story carried by the Hudson, East River, streets, and bridges.
outro: We return to the Battery, where the completed growth rings frame a five-borough harbor still reaching toward the world.

eras.label: New Amsterdam
eras.narration: Dutch settlers establish New Amsterdam around the Battery, behind a defensive wall and palisade where the Hudson and East River meet.

eras.label: Colonial Harbor
eras.narration: The colonial port pushes north past Wall Street as bustling wharves line the East River, drawing transatlantic trade toward the shoreline.

eras.label: Commissioners' Plan
eras.narration: The Commissioners' Plan of 1811 imposes a rectilinear street grid northward through Greenwich Village, defining the city's future avenues.

eras.label: Central Park & Midtown
eras.narration: Olmsted and Vaux shape Central Park's Greensward plan as Midtown fills with avenues, hotels, and brownstones beyond the old city core.

eras.label: Brooklyn Bridge
eras.narration: The Brooklyn Bridge leaps across the East River, binding Brooklyn to Manhattan and turning the river into a metropolitan crossroads.

eras.label: Greater New York
eras.narration: Greater New York consolidates Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island, uniting rivers, roads, and rail into one giant metropolis.

eras.label: Vertical Metropolis
eras.narration: Art deco spires spear into the clouds as the subway network rapidly expands, cementing New York's identity as a towering vertical titan.

eras.label: Global Harbor Gateway
eras.narration: Today waterfronts thrive across all five boroughs, as the outer growth rings complete their sweep and return to the historic harbor.
